title: A Gravity for the Machine
author: T. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Ada Joubert, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
